critical_code_review_comments: routes/health.py:793 _valid_hhmm regex '([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d' correctly rejects 24:00 / 25:00 / bad minutes — verified via 400 test.

routes/health.py:864 DVZ formula gross*12/365 is the standard SK Sociálna poisťovňa denný vymeriavací základ approximation — matches spec 27.95 for 850€ gross. Percentages 25%/55%/55% match 2026 SK rules. shortfall_pct threshold at 30% for solidarity_suggested is a reasonable heuristic.
routes/health.py:867 DPP/DPČ warning correctly appended without blocking — user still gets an estimate but is informed about optional insurance requirement. Honest UX.

routes/health.py:894 recovery_report_pdf uses _auth_pdf(authorization, token) — allows Bearer header OR ?token= query param (same pattern as testament/tos/proxy PDFs in iteration 5). 404 on missing record instead of empty PDF — correct.

frontend/app/my-recovery.tsx:140 uses SafeAreaView with edges=['top'] only — good for bottom-fixed CTA. All 20+ testIDs match iteration 10 spec verbatim. Live outing card computed client-side from outings + current wall clock — no server round-trip needed for the countdown.
AI outing extraction at routes/health.py:846 correctly filters returned JSON by _valid_hhmm — bulletproof against LLM hallucinations of '25:00' etc. Falls back to found:false gracefully.
